event.description: minimal one-head one-layer d1 ff1 scored probe
event.proposal: Family: attention organization. Retained incumbent is 6080 parameters at 100%, margin 1.00 points over 99%. Most recent accepted result in this family: none; most recent failed result: attempt-0001 at d2 h1 L2 ff1, 160 parameters and 0%; prior attempts in this family: 1. Hypothesis: collapsing to one attention layer and scalar state tests whether depth, rather than width, is the dominant irreducible resource. This is more informative than repeating the prior d2/L2 probe because it changes depth and parameterization simultaneously while retaining the mandatory self-attention contract. One-step training is a declared compute bound, so a failure will be classified as nonqualification only if the official verifier returns a score.
